records.claim: pi-workflow-engine 1.2.0 enforces structured-output contracts: schema agents deliver only through a validated final_answer tool, with two repair attempts before failing closed.

records.credibility: Usage documentation inside the exact published version — version-anchored documentation.
records.notes: Confirms the deterministic structured-output boundary the infrastructure note describes.

records.claim: Between 0.28.0 and 0.44.0, the pi-web-access changelog contains no Breaking or Removed sections and no entry that removes or renames web_search, fetch_content, source_check, or get_search_content.

records.notes: The 17-version gap (0.27.0 → 0.44.0) is the largest of the four packages; the scan was section-header-level, so subtle behavior changes could exist inside Changed sections without a Breaking header.
